user_settings_profile.SUBTITLE: Preferences & Security
user_settings_profile.BACKUP_EXPORT_ACCESSIBILITY: Backup tasks and open share sheet
user_settings_profile.DELETE_COMPLETED_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION: Only completed tasks that are not already in Trash will be permanently deleted. Active tasks will not be changed.
user_settings_profile.EMPTY_TRASH_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION: All tasks currently in Trash will be permanently deleted. Active tasks and app settings will not be changed.
user_settings_profile.REPLACE_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION: This replaces the entire current task list with {count} backup tasks. Existing tasks will be removed; this cannot be undone.
user_settings_profile.MERGE_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION: This imports {count} backup tasks and retains existing tasks with different IDs.
user_settings_profile.RESTORE_DESCRIPTION: Paste a TaskLume JSON backup. Only records with a non-empty title will be imported.
user_settings_profile.BACKUP_JSON_PLACEHOLDER: Paste JSON backup or a tasks JSON object
user_settings_profile.INVALID_BACKUP_JSON: Backup JSON must contain a task array with at least one valid title.
user_settings_profile.INVALID_BACKUP_RESTORE: Enter a valid backup before restoring.
user_settings_profile.RESTORE_FAILED_UNCONFIRMED: Restore could not be completed; success was not confirmed.
user_settings_profile.RESTORE_FAILED: Restore could not be completed. Review the backup and try again.
